name: MyBot check-in
description: Asks one question each evening so the record stays complete.
schedule: Daily at 21:00 in the owner's timezone, or the time the owner picks when switching it on.
quiet_when: Not switched on by the owner, no record yet, today already logged, or paused.
job: Run the check-in in mybot-main-job. Read the Sheet first. Send one short question, at most one message, never a chaser.
